candidate_universe_policy.description: A bounded comparison slice of three exchange-listed beer issuers: a national operator, a multi-region operator and a regional operator with a disclosed production-network intervention. The slice tests whether a whole-listed-entity responsibility unit has both recurring annual-report measurements and a non-common directional fact. It is not represented as every listed Chinese brewer.

cohort_screen.company_name: 重庆啤酒股份有限公司
cohort_screen.reason: The whole listed group disclosed the same annual beer-volume, consolidated operating statement, operating-cash-flow and working-capital identities for three consecutive years. Before cutoff it had also closed production operations at six breweries, while realized revenue per kilolitre and cash working-capital release moved in a direction not shared by a mechanical last-observed baseline.

cohort_screen.company_name: 青岛啤酒股份有限公司
cohort_screen.reason: The bounded 2015 report disclosed growth in high-value product volume, but this minimal screen did not identify a finite, already implemented resource commitment whose central unit-economics prediction differed from simply carrying the last observed mix direction forward. Selecting it here would require an arbitrary threshold or turn the baseline into the primary.

cohort_screen.company_name: 北京燕京啤酒股份有限公司
cohort_screen.reason: The bounded 2015 report disclosed can-volume and fresh-beer growth, but the minimal packet did not establish a discrete intervention boundary that made a central operating result differ from last-observed continuation without importing a management plan. It remains a possible later episode after a separately bounded event search.

selection_reason: Select the consolidated listed issuer rather than an acquired subsidiary or a management-defined future project. The directional case rests on an implemented six-brewery production-network pruning, realized revenue-per-kilolitre improvement and recurring cash-working-capital release, while the rival remains live because beer volume, operating-contribution margin and selling-cost pressure were adverse. No management sales target is used.

outcome_firewall.attestation: The selector enumerated only the CNINFO universe whose query end date was 2016-04-30 and programmatically asserted that no returned row exceeded the cutoff. No post-cutoff outcome title, filename, snippet, body, price or result was queried or viewed.

pre_admission_recurring_disclosure_gate.responsibility_unit: The legal consolidated listed issuer CN:600132, not a subsidiary, plant, brand or post-acquisition segment.
pre_admission_recurring_disclosure_gate.proof: Three consecutive ordinary annual reports repeat annual company beer sales volume, consolidated revenue, cost, taxes and surcharges, selling expense, administrative expense, operating cash flow, cash paid to acquire fixed/intangible/other long-term assets and the balance-sheet working-capital accounts. Plant closures alter the operating configuration inside this fixed issuer perimeter; they do not change the responsibility-unit identity.

central_discriminator_identities.metric_identity: consolidated operating revenue - consolidated operating cost - taxes and surcharges - selling expense - administrative expense
central_discriminator_identities.segment_boundary: Whole consolidated issuer for every numerator component; no product-volume denominator or plant/brand allocation.
central_discriminator_identities.disclosure_change_risk: The 2015 report reclassified supply-chain expense from administrative expense into manufacturing cost. The whole-issuer amount includes both accounts plus recurring taxes and surcharges and is invariant to that transfer. Beer-only volume and standalone gross margin cannot settle the selection.

central_discriminator_identities.metric_identity: consolidated OCF less cash paid to acquire fixed/intangible/other long-term assets less max(opening cash working capital - ending cash working capital, 0), where cash working capital is accounts receivable + prepayments + inventory - accounts payable - customer advances
central_discriminator_identities.segment_boundary: Whole consolidated issuer and the same consolidated statements as D3. Opening and ending working capital are formula inputs; the settled observation is owner cash excluding positive working-capital release.
central_discriminator_identities.disclosure_change_risk: A future accounting-label change may require an explicit issuer bridge. Missing opening/ending customer-advance, comparable working-capital or long-term-asset-acquisition cash-flow fields produces MEASUREMENT_MISMATCH or UNKNOWN; no subsidiary, parent-only or group-survival proxy is allowed.

pre_admission_recurring_disclosure_gate.why_r102_failure_does_not_repeat: R-104 does not rely on a newly acquired subsidiary remaining separately disclosed. Both central discriminators are measured at the legal consolidated issuer perimeter that already carried the same recurring identities in three cutoff-before ordinary annual reports.
pre_admission_recurring_disclosure_gate.prohibited_assumption: This gate does not assert that a particular post-cutoff report or value exists. It admits the case from cutoff-before recurring legal-reporting identity only.

production_throughput_observability_gate.required_identity: Whole-consolidated-issuer beer production throughput, sell-through or capacity utilization distinct from sales volume

cutoff_before_findings.FY2013: The annual report gives annual beer sales volume but no whole-issuer production volume, sell-through or capacity-utilization series.
cutoff_before_findings.FY2014: The annual report gives annual beer sales volume but no whole-issuer production volume, sell-through or capacity-utilization series.
cutoff_before_findings.FY2015: The annual report first gives a product-table production total of 88.77 ten-thousand kl and a rounded minus-6-percent year-on-year change. The rounded comparison cannot reconstruct an exact FY2014 production value or create a recurring FY2013-FY2015 identity.
cutoff_before_findings.plant_capacity: The disclosed Yibin future relocation design capacity is a single-plant commitment and cannot represent whole-issuer utilization.

production_throughput_observability_gate.prohibited_response: Do not copy D2 sales volume into a D3 product-volume claim and do not derive an exact prior-year production value from a rounded percentage.
production_throughput_observability_gate.admission_impact: The product contract defines five mandatory D1-D5 layers and treats D3_PRODUCT_VOLUME as optional. R-104 therefore preserves production throughput as UNKNOWN and a non-voter. The refrozen central D3 measures whole-issuer operating-contribution amount and does not claim to isolate the production-utilization arrow.

source_selection_boundary: The annual reports are used for realized facts and recurring measurement identities. Management targets, the stated 2016 sales plan, later disclosure availability, stock prices and post-cutoff events are excluded.
selection_stop_rule: Stop after three consecutive ordinary annual reports prove the whole-issuer D3/D4 identities and the 2015 report supplies an implemented resource commitment plus a live rival. Do not enumerate any post-cutoff inventory until a genuinely independent pre-outcome reviewer accepts the exact freeze and measurement contract.
